calibration_covariance.contrasts: C_d = D C_b D^T, read off the SAME joint matrix; no independent recomputation

calibration_covariance.equivalence_demonstration: option B (central differences of the fully profiled pseudo-true parameter) agrees with option A at every entry within both methods' certified enclosures

calibration_covariance.joint_matrix: C_b,cal = J_beta C_phi J_beta^T over all eight log-beta endpoints

calibration_covariance.sensitivity_method: U.20 option A: implicit differentiation of the expected-score system, d theta*/d phi = -(d_theta E s)^{-1} d_phi E s
calibration_covariance.shared_primitive_rule: one LATENT standard variable per shared standard; the loading structure survives into the generating law, so a control that drops the covariance still faces data that carry it
calibration_covariance.structural_zeros: a zero J_beta row is permitted only where the primitive provably does not enter the analysis model; the zero is detected, recorded and separately re-derived numerically

numerical_error_certification.contractivity: the Lipschitz constant ||F_cl||_w^2 is bounded over the BALL by epsilon inflation, not at a midpoint; a recomputed bound that does not fit back inside the inflated ball refuses certification
numerical_error_certification.linear_solve: residual enclosed in interval arithmetic with the matrix entries entering as the intervals they are
numerical_error_certification.method: interval-arithmetic hyper-dual differentiation of the expected-score system
numerical_error_certification.nonsingularity: lambda_min >= mu PROVED by an interval Cholesky of S - mu I; the V5 Weyl-plus-reconstruction estimate, which subtracted a RELATIVE residual as if absolute, is removed
numerical_error_certification.qualification_rule: PASS iff u+ <= c; FAIL iff u- > c; UNRESOLVED otherwise, with inclusive ceiling semantics and c never widened
numerical_error_certification.riccati_derivative: the SAME estimate, read back per component from the grading: dP/dtheta, dP/dphi and the mixed second derivative each carry their own bound
numerical_error_certification.riccati_value: a posteriori contraction estimate on the hyper-dual iterate, in the graded Banach-algebra norm |x0| + w|x1| + w|x2| + w^2|x12|
numerical_error_certification.square_root: candidate from math.sqrt, PROVED by exact rational comparison of lo*lo <= a_lo and hi*hi >= a_hi; no IEEE-754 or libm property is appealed to

transcendentals.arithmetic_guarantee: General Decimal Arithmetic specification: add, subtract, multiply and divide are correctly rounded under the context rounding mode
transcendentals.exp_reduction: y = x / 2**k exactly, |y| <= 1/2, then k squarings
transcendentals.input_conversion: Decimal(float) and math.frexp/math.ldexp, both exact on the binary value; no decimal display string is parsed
transcendentals.log_reduction: x = m * 2**e exactly; log x = log m + e log 2
transcendentals.route: self-contained interval series over decimal basic arithmetic
transcendentals.sqrt: candidate from math.sqrt, PROVED by exact rational comparison

numerical_error_certification.truncation_error: EXACTLY ZERO: the chain rule is evaluated, not approximated; there is no step size

the exp series was evaluated with signed terms, where rounding an intermediate downward does not bound the next one
ginnovation_mean's early-out tested only the VALUE component, so at the linearisation point it discarded the centre rows of the expected information and made the system singular
blockers_repaired: the numerical sensitivity certification rested on an undocumented libm property, bounded the Riccati VALUE only, and reported that bound rather than using it
the axial remainder set used an informal marginal 3 sigma instead of U's joint 99.9% physical region
the official C_phi path omitted ten of the fifteen required calibration primitive categories
the 0.0005 absolute and contrast bounded-bias ceilings were computed and never compared against anything
observation qualification omitted P, so it compared detector noise against the LATENT covariance, and it read the Branch-B fit
gate-calibration provenance was a typed artifact an ordinary caller could fill with anything
CTL-ETA-T-COV drew no auxiliary measurement and CTL-AXIAL-MEMORY's temporal qualification was a hand-set flag
